mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 34 degrees with overcast skies near Harriet Park under a full moon. The overnight low will reach 34 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

If you are interested in the 2027 Spring Election, candidate packets are ready for pickup at the City Clerk's office. Also, remember that property tax bills will be mailed by December 15, and you have various ways to pay including online, by mail, or at the 24/7 drop box.
There is plenty to do this week, including live music at Paddy Mac's today, trivia at The Bogey Factory tomorrow, and the Verona Crafty Fair this Friday.
On November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a driver unconscious in their vehicle; she was subsequently arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Dark Chocolate Decadence. The store is currently open until 10:00 PM, so there is still time to stop by for a treat.
